A clear route from discovery to launch
1. Discovery and scope
Discuss your business goals, audience, current platform and constraints. Identify requirements, dependencies and the decisions needed before work begins.
2. Design and development
Connect layouts and user journeys with implementation. Agree review points and prioritise the features needed for the first release.
3. Testing and launch
Review the agreed functionality, device experience and performance. Prepare deployment, handover and the checks required for release.
4. Maintenance and improvement
Discuss ongoing support and the next set of improvements. Agree which updates are included and how new requests will be handled.

Questions about working with Shardwise
What services does Shardwise offer?

Shardwise offers website and application development, design, website and ecommerce maintenance, and SEO. Specialist services include WordPress, Shopify, iOS and Android development, technical SEO, AEO and GEO.
Can I enquire about a project targeting UK or US customers?

Yes. Use the contact page to describe your target market, project requirements and preferred working hours. Delivery arrangements, review schedules and support scope can then be discussed for your project.
How much does a website or app project cost?

Cost depends on the platform, features, integrations, design requirements and ongoing support. Share your requirements and budget range so an appropriate scope can be discussed. The website does not publish a fixed minimum project price.
How long does development take?
Timelines depend on complexity, content readiness, integrations and review cycles. Milestones and dependencies need to be discussed before agreeing a delivery schedule.
Do you maintain websites and ecommerce stores after launch?
Yes. The service catalog includes website maintenance, Shopify store maintenance and WooCommerce maintenance. Tasks, frequency and support arrangements are agreed for the project.
What is the difference between SEO, AEO and GEO?

SEO improves the foundations and content used by search engines to discover and understand pages. AEO focuses on clear answers to user questions. GEO, or generative engine optimisation, focuses on making business information and content understandable in AI-generated search experiences. These approaches overlap; none guarantees rankings or AI citations.
Does serving UK and US businesses mean you have offices there?
The UK and US are the target markets described on this page. That does not establish a physical office in either country. Ask about delivery arrangements through the contact page.
How do I start?
Use the contact page to share your name, email, selected service and project message. Include your goals, existing website or app, target country, budget range and any deadline constraints.

Launching a website, planning an app or reviewing your search visibility? Share your goals and requirements with Shardwise so we can discuss a practical next step.
